facts.fact: Mauritius's Prime Minister told Parliament that CERT-MU, under the ministry of ICT, runs MAUCORS+, the national platform for reporting cybersecurity incidents and online offences.
The Prime Minister said the Cybercrime Unit handled 837 cases from January 2023 to November 2025, with 120 people arrested and five cases sent to court, and no conviction yet.
The Prime Minister gave a count of 837 cases handled by the Cybercrime Unit between January 2023 and November 2025, including 167 closed, 640 under investigation and 21 awaiting the DPP.

MUS.note: Says cybercrime reports may be made at any police station; no station record system described.
